title: Why SOCI belongs in the build
summary: Most of a large container's startup goes to pulling and decompressing files it never reads to boot. SOCI makes the image seekable so the runtime loads only the bytes it needs, and Depot writes that index during the build, so the image can lazy-load the instant it's pushed.
body_markdown: Push with the SOCI output options on your` depot build` : set` soci=true` alongside` compression=gzip` in the` -o type=image,...` flags, since SOCI only indexes gzip layers. Adding` force-compression=true` re-encodes every layer, including base-image layers pulled from elsewhere, as gzip so the whole image can be indexed. Once the image is pushed it carries the zTOC metadata right next to the normal layers.
